The koine fourth opinion as a lens

Source: R/lens_builtin.R
lens_koine.Rd

Declares koine's synthesised opinion as a lens without fitting anything yet. The lens's fit() calls emit_koine() on the specification and data it is handed and canonicalises the result. The specification is the hub's fb_terms intermediate representation; a fitted hub model is accepted in its place and the representation is taken from it, because different hub fits carry it at $fb and at $extras$fb_terms and a lens that read only one of the two would decline half the hub's fits for a reason that has nothing to do with koine. koine is already self-naming, so the canonicalisation is a pass-through there; it is the same code path a hub fit takes, which is what keeps the two lenses' parameter tokens identical by construction rather than by coincidence.

Usage

lens_koine(name = "koine", ...)

Arguments

name

Single non-empty string naming the lens.

...

Further arguments passed to emit_koine() at fit time, such as n_samples (the count of opinion draws to synthesise) and seed.

Value

A quorum_lens() of kind parameters whose fit(spec, data) returns a quorum_draws() over the canonical parameters, or a quorum_abstention() with reason engine_missing (koine is not installed), spec_missing (the fitted model handed in carries no parsed model), lens_abstained (koine stood down on this model, with the nested reason attached) or draws_unavailable.

Details

koine is the independent witness on the methodological axis: a stacked battery of independent lenses synthesised into one opinion, not another sampler over the hub's objective. Its corner is a population GLM with at most two crossed or nested random intercepts, and outside that corner – or whenever koine's own convergence gate fires – it stands down. The lens re-types that as a lens_abstained decline carrying koine's own reason, so an abstaining lens contributes no number to the quorum and the reader still learns why.

See also

emit_koine() for the opinion itself, lens_from_fit() to wrap a koine fit already in hand.

Examples

l <- lens_koine()
S7::prop(l, "shares")
#>        sampler      objective         priors      data_prep 
#>  "koine_stack"        "koine" "koine_scaled"       "quorum"
